audience: developers and video teams who host videos and live streams on api.video

useCases.title: Find your most played videos
useCases.text: The AI reads play analytics for a date range, grouped by a dimension you choose, and looks up the video titles. You see which videos get the most plays.

useCases.title: Check if a video is ready to play
useCases.text: The AI reads the upload progress, the encoding qualities and the playability of a video, plus its player URL. You know if it finished processing.

useCases.title: Find videos by tag, title or metadata
useCases.text: The AI lists videos that match a title, tag, metadata or description filter and sorts them. You get titles and links for a group of videos, for example all videos with one tag.

useCases.title: Review live streams and how they are watched
useCases.text: The AI lists live streams and reads one stream's stream key, RTMP ingest and player URL. It can also read play analytics for live streams over a date range.

useCases.title: Create a video or update its details
useCases.text: The AI finds a video and changes only the fields you give it, such as the title. You can also have it create a new video from a public video URL.
